[SWS_DM_01253] Support of supplier service validations
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04199
⌈
The DM shall support supplier specific service validation checks according to
ISO 14229-1[1] by calling
ara::diag::ServiceValidation::Validate
for each
configured supplier service check.
